4.9 stars. 841 reviews. On a beach island in Vietnam.

Bombay Indian Restaurant Phú Quốc is pulling numbers most restaurants in any city would kill for. Butter chicken, dal makhani, fresh naan. Real north Indian cooking, not watered-down tourist food.

Dinner for two lands around $30. That's it.

If you're craving something that isn't seafood or pho, this is the move. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
